from sfx import *
import sfx
import math, scipy, scipy.signal as signal
from scipy.signal import butter,sosfilt,lfilter,sawtooth,resample_poly,fftconvolve
import numpy as np
X=sx=SFX=sfx
rng=np.random.default_rng(97)
sfx._rng=np.random.default_rng(97)
DUR=1.4
N=round(DUR*SR)
t=np.arange(12000)/SR


def switch_click(v=1.0):                    # switch bottoming out: small click + low thock
    d = .12; tt = t_(d)
    x = hp(noise(d), 4000) * env_exp(d, .0012) + np.sin(2 * np.pi * 3400 * tt) * env_exp(d, .004) * .4
    x += np.sin(2 * np.pi * 240 * tt) * env_exp(d, .022) * .9 + lp(noise(d), 900) * env_exp(d, .01) * .5
    return norm(x) * v

samples = switch_click()
